result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by requiring mutual written agreement for renewal and capping renewal fee increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%. It preserves the unrelated termination provisions. However, limiting mutually agreed renewals to successive 12-month periods is more restrictive than necessary because the 12-month requirement applies to the automatic-renewal alternative, not the mutual-agreement alternative. The clause also leaves duplicative and defective renewal language in Sections II and III—particularly “mutual written of the parties”—and does not define the applicable CPI, reducing drafting quality.
